notes: No amp+cab block — running into tube amp. Amp voicing compensated via Parametric EQ. Delays are tempo-synced to 112 BPM. Nick Valensi Minotaur (Klon Centaur) confirmed notable user.

compressor.notes: Confirmed on Hammond's board. Provides the consistent, slightly squashed dynamics central to the Strokes' compressed, even-attack rhythm character. ACTIVE in both snapshots at the same settings — compression is a constant tonal foundation. Mix at 70% blends compressed and dry signal to maintain some pick attack transient.

overdrive.notes: Approximates Jekyll & Hyde overdrive side. Mid-forward asymmetric clipping.

boost.notes: Nick Valensi confirmed Klon user per YAML. Approximates MXR Micro Amp clean boost for lead passages. BYPASSED in Snapshot 1, ACTIVE in Snapshot 2.

eq.notes: Telephone filter EQ is the defining Strokes character — aggressive low and high cut with boosted mids. Also compensates for removed amp voicing. Single mid band only.

delay.notes: Delays are tempo-synced to 112 BPM. Snapshot 1: eighth note (268ms). Snapshot 2: dotted eighth (402ms) — the prominent echo-soaked lead tone central to this song.

1_rhythm.description: Main rhythm tone. Stupor OD at Drive 6.5. Minotaur bypassed. Telephone filter EQ with Mid +5dB at 700Hz. Eighth note delay at low mix.

2_lead.description: Echo-soaked lead tone for intertwining guitar lines after first chorus. Minotaur active for level boost. Dotted eighth delay at 48% mix — prominent and defining. Slightly less driven OD.

playing_notes.pickup_notes: Neck or middle for rhythm (Snapshot 1), bridge for lead lines (Snapshot 2)
playing_notes.technique: Single-note picked chord fragments rather than full strummed chords. Pick deliberately and let compression do sustain work.
playing_notes.snapshot_cues: Switch to Snapshot 2 for Valensi intertwining lead lines after first chorus. Delay at 48% mix does the braiding — play with space and let notes sustain into each other.
